DataCalcInsightTemplate.description: Number of branch offices per region and country (Branch_Office__dlm). Added for the data-kit update-only promotion test.
DataCalcInsightTemplate.expression: SELECT COUNT(Branch_Office__dlm.OfficeCode__c) AS office_count__c, Branch_Office__dlm.Region__c AS region__c, Branch_Office__dlm.Country__c AS country__c FROM Branch_Office__dlm GROUP BY region__c, country__c
